Suslanger and its surroundings

The city stands beside a lake feeding irrigation canals. The people working its fields are unarmed, but must raise the alarm at the sight of strangers or face punishment themselves.

Shelter at Rindeil’s estate

Rindeil welcomes Kel and her companion to his estate. Kir’s learning gives them common ground, though the collector’s chief concern remains his spiders. Karim, who manages the household and formerly performed on stage, becomes a source of contacts and rumours about another Joon. Feiruz helps Kir hide his conspicuous face beneath cloth, exploiting the fear of disease. Rindeil’s requests include obtaining a meteorite sample in exchange for a rare specimen for his collection. This period of refuge lets Kir search for information, but its safety depends on the owner’s willingness to risk his household. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]

Zara’s affairs

The merchant Zara is another of Kel’s Suslanger contacts. Her side of the story involves a blackmailer, a threatened caravan and contraband that must be recovered before the authorities inspect it. The conversations distinguish successful recovery from arriving too late; the account of the caravan therefore depends on the outcome of that errand. Later, Zara’s interest in a scholar draws Kir into a scheme against Kehel. These dealings develop alongside the search for a Joon, rather than forming a single inevitable sequence of victories. [7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14]
